tools.name: faktuo_create_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Generate an invoice, proforma, tax document for an advance, or quote as a PDF from the fields you send. Send the supplier and items; add a customer and doc_number as needed. Faktuo keeps no record: nothing appears in the Faktuo account and no number is assigned. Returns { filename, byteLength, pdfBa

tools.name: faktuo_create_credit_note_pdf
tools.description: Generate a credit note (opravný doklad / storno) as a PDF that cancels one invoice. Send the original invoice's number in corrects and positive amounts; the PDF labels the total as 'to be refunded'. Faktuo keeps no record and links it to no invoice in the account. Returns { filename, byteLength, pdf
